name: watch-prs-and-ci
description: One daemon per user subscribes PRs and delivers comments, reviews, CI verdicts, head moves, merges, and closes as messages instead of polls.

interface.shortDescription: PR events and CI verdicts delivered as messages, not polls.
interface.longDescription: After a push or a PR open, one watch call subscribes the session to the PR with its permission mode, pushed head, and gate workflows. One daemon per user per machine polls GitHub through GraphQL at a 60 s floor and delivers comments, reviews, CI verdicts with failed-job logs, head moves, merges, and closes as cross-session messages and as a log other agents read with wait.
defaultPrompt: Push this and tell me when CI or a review comes back.
Did the pipeline pass for my last push?
Watch this PR for reviews and its merge.
